'''Freeze-floating control''',<ref name="ANHN">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars: A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref> also known as a '''control unit''',<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 6" /> was sub-system of the computer aboard [[Airspeeder/Legends|aircraft]] and [[Starship/Legends|starships]] which created a smoother flight by helping counter the effects of turbulence. They were used in [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]].<ref name="ANHN" />
